title: David Grusch Claims He Saw Government Video of "Beautiful" Dead Aliens

content:
In a new interview with Joe Rogan, UFO Disclosure celebrity David Grusch made an extraordinary claim that he had seen “contemporary” footage of “beautiful” dead Nordic aliens several years ago, which he both failed to reveal to Congress in his sworn testimony and which he is now sharing in great detail with Joe Rogan, despite the footage supposedly being classified and therefore illegal to discuss in any form for someone who holds a security clearance, as Grusch does. Grusch did not explain how he supposedly gained access to this footage, though he implied it was leaked to him. This follows a pattern where Grusch tops his previous claims with an increasingly implausible new one every time attention on him fades below his required celebrity threshold. 

ROGAN: How do you know that for sure?

 GRUSCH: I got to see the audiovisual on that stuff.

 ROGAN: You got to see what?

 GRUSCH: So, I've got to be a little vague only because I want to protect the sources, because it may indicate a specific activity or operation. And these people were very patriotic, and they were just dead cadavers, you know, on the ground because it was a retrieval activity.

 ROGAN: You saw them physically, or you saw video of them?

 GRUSCH: Video.

 ROGAN: Video. So you saw a dead cadaver that was at a crash?

 GRUSCH: Yes.

 ROGAN: So, they filmed the crash, and they filmed these cadavers.

 GRUSCH: Yeah.

 ROGAN: How old is this footage?

 GRUSCH: I don't want to say. It's contemporary. But I don't want to reveal a particular operation because it narrows it down.

 ROGAN: But it's clear. It's not like you're looking at 1950s black and white. But, it's clear.

 GRUSCH: Do know, when I get that kind of information, you know, I’m like, ‘Tell me what it is, what happened,’ and I put it out for collection so to speak and then I confirm it independently because I was very allergic to any kind of deception, right? Because, and the advent of AI—Sora AI—you can create a very realistic (sic), and so I was very anal retentive when I was given documents, audiovisual, etc., and I still sat on that stuff for like years until I felt comfortable with that not being some sort of limited hangout or deception activity.

 ROGAN: What did it look like?

 GRUSCH: Human-looking.

 ROGAN: How human?

 GRUSCH: Very.

 ROGAN: Looked like a human, or looked similar to a human?

 GRUSCH: Very, very beautiful.

 ROGAN: What color was the skin?

 GRUSCH: Bluish white. And it wasn’t super-close…

 ROGAN: Like Avatar?

 GRUSCH: No, no, no.

 ROGAN: Like someone who drowned?

 GRUSCH: Like a pale sort of albino. And it’s interesting, and I said this in another interview that’s not out yet, but—and, God willing, this is my last interview for a while, hopefully, in pre-Disclosure environment, you know [crosses self]—and General [William] McCasland, when he was talking to [Tom] DeLonge, and this is public record—Tom’s talked about it on, I think, your show and other interviews—where he always told Tom, "Think of the Greek gods." Yeah, true, you can look it up. And now I kind of understand what he meant. 

​McCasland, 68, who was suffering from health issues and growing mental and memory problems (described as “brain fog”) shortly before he disappeared earlier this year, is widely suspected to have either taken his own life or suffered an accident after walking into the New Mexico desert. Grusch went on to imply that the government assassinated the retired McCasland for knowing too much about UFOs, a fate that Grusch has somehow miraculously escaped despite sharing the government’s alleged UFO secrets on every podcast in America.

 During the nearly three-hour interview, Grusch also alleged that the government is not hiding he existence of aliens because they fear public panic but because they fear exposure of contract fraud that resulted in defense contractors receiving no-bid contracts to reverse-engineer UFOs and sell the tech back to the government. (Really? They are afraid that financial misappropriation will be exposed? Has he met Donald Trump?) Grusch also predicted that Trump will reveal the existence of aliens shortly before the 2028 presidential election, presumably in a last-ditch attempt at influencing the outcome.
